stages.claim: Existing base server fields survive read/merge and become source=settings editable=true.
Ordinary full editor permits a new unique name and emits a newly built next with only authorable fields; these three fields are omitted.
New name receives only whitelist patch; old key is null in same atomic update. Previous server is used only to generate deleted env/header subkeys, not to copy extra supported fields.
For absent new key stripNulls inserts only supplied authorable fields; old:null removes complete original. No source of the three omitted supported fields remains under new key.
If name stays old, recursive merge starts from existing record; absent extra fields remain. This counterexample limits the issue specifically to rename, not all save operations.
